_comment: Dad Coach on the AI Workflow Platform: one worker, dad_3, owning the dad-coach-3 workflow. Dad Coach names the worker and the workflow on every call (WORKFLOW_PLATFORM_WORKER_KEY / _WORKFLOW_KEY); the platform never chooses. The daily check is a workflow schedule into the hub (ACTIVE_COACHING), INSTANCE timezone - Dad Coach sends the father's timezone on every execute. Session timers are AI-armed scheduled transitions into one-shot states (the YAML).
